title: Rivet build
description: Builds a Rivet app with Vite: the client build (one per locale with @rivetjs/i18n), the server build, then the prerender step for static apps.

config.description: Vite config file, relative to the project (default: Vite's lookup).

ssr.description: Also run the server build (vite build --ssr). Default: true, except csr-mode apps.

prerender.description: Prerender every page after the builds. Default: true for rivetRouter({ mode: "static" }) apps.

locales.description: One client build per locale (RIVET_LOCALE). Inferred from i18n.config.ts.

outputPath.description: Build output folder, relative to the project.

env.description: Extra environment variables for every step.
